_comment: Names on the Species, Origin and Careers pages that the Talents or Skills page spells differently, applied by scripts/gen-data.js. "talents" also renames the base of "Base (Specialisation)"; "skills" fixes misspelt skill names. Each entry's reason is in _sources.

_sources.Read/Write: Talents page: Datapad Use replaces any other form of literacy
_sources.Datapad Literate: Same literacy rule; Datapad Literate is not a talent on the Talents page
_sources.Animal Affinity: The Talents page and its random table use Creature Affinity
_sources.Warleader: The Talents page spells it War Leader
